data.caveat: The low suspension fee preserves the number only; active SMS requires normal service.
data.evidence: Current rules; independent outcome coverage limited

data.inactivity_window: This is a monthly contract, not an inactivity-based prepaid line. A Voice+Data line can be placed on Sakura’s suspension option to keep the number while service is paused.
data.clock_start_or_reset: Normal service follows monthly billing. Suspension is applied for full calendar months through My Page according to the plan-change schedule.
qualifying_activity: Continue paying the normal Voice+Data monthly plan.
For number retention without service, use the documented Voice+Data suspension option at ¥220/month with credit-card payment.
If moving carriers, request MNP before submitting termination.
non_qualifying_or_unknown_activity: Suspension provides no calls, SMS or data, so it preserves the number but does not provide OTP continuity.
If the ¥220 suspension fee is unpaid, Sakura states the contract will be terminated.
After submitting termination, a plan change or MNP request can no longer be submitted.
data.lowest_cost_documented_action: Use Sakura’s Voice+Data suspension option at ¥220 per month if you only need to retain the current number and do not need calls/SMS/data during suspension.
data.safest_documented_action: If ongoing OTP/SMS access matters, keep the normal Voice+Data plan active. If you only need future ownership, use the official suspension option and keep the credit card valid.

minimum_expected_cost.note: Credit-card payment is required; suspended service has no call/SMS/data access.

recommended_buffer.basis: Product-side buffer before Sakura’s normal 25th-of-month plan-change/termination cutoff.

data.grace_or_rescue_window: No fixed unpaid grace period was found in the reviewed official pages. The suspension article says an unpaid suspension fee terminates the contract.
data.termination_and_recycling: Termination occurs at month-end according to the request cutoff. Users who want to keep the number should request MNP before termination; Sakura says an MNP request can no longer be submitted after a termination request. Exact post-termination recycling timing is not documented in the cited pages.

reminder.reason: No single verified keep-alive deadline can be generated safely for this monthly route. The documented 25th-of-month cutoff is for plan changes/termination, not a universal payment-expiry deadline.
